LanguageData.SSC_Role_NoAssignable: No assignable roles are available for this slave.
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_ShacklesDefault_Desc: Choose whether to put the shackles on when you enslave the pawn. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_SlaveStage_Desc: Choose whether to activate the slave's emotional changes. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_RebelCycle_Desc: Choose whether to enable Rebellion Cycle Change by Slave Stage. If the slave stage is off, it has no effect. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_RemoveWorkDebuff_Title: Remove Global Work Speed Debuff On/Off
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_RemoveWorkDebuff_Desc: Choose whether to Remove Global Work Speed Debuff by Slave Stage. If the slave stage is off, it has no effect. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_AssignSlave_Desc: Choose whether to allow slaves to be assigned to roles. If the slave stage is off, it has no effect. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage5WorkUnlock_Title: Unlock Work/Ritual Restrictions for Stage 5 Slaves On/Off
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage5WorkUnlock_Desc: Allows stage 5 slaves to perform all work types and participate in ritual roles without restrictions. If the slave stage is off, this option has no effect. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Assimilation_Desc: Choose whether to allow the slave's faction to be changed to the player's faction when the slave stage reaches level 5. If you release the slave who has become the player's faction, the slave will join the settlement. If the slave stage is off, it has no effect. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_RemoteOnlyConsole_Title: Activate Collars Only at Comms Console On/Off
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_RemoteOnlyConsole_Desc: Choose whether the remote activation button for slave collars can only be operated from the Comms Console, and not directly by the slaves. When remote activation is attempted, a colonist must go to the Comms Console to activate it manually. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage1Period_Desc: Sets the slave stage 1 period. Default: 15 days
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage2Period_Desc: Sets the slave stage 2 period. Default: 15 days
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage3Period_Desc: Sets the slave stage 3 period. Default: 15 days
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_Stage4Period_Desc: Sets the slave stage 4 period. Default: 15 days
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_CollarCharge_Desc: Collars consume power and become inactive when depleted. Wardens recharge at consoles. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_CollarDisruption_Desc: Collars are temporarily disabled by EMP hits or solar flares. Default: On
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_DrainMultiplier_Desc: Multiplied to all collar power drain. 1 = default, 0.5 = half, 2 = double. Default: 1
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_DefaultRechargeThreshold_Des: Initial auto-recharge threshold for newly equipped collars. Adjustable per-collar via the charge gizmo. Default: 50%
LanguageData.SSC_Stat_BatteryCapacity_Desc: Maximum battery capacity of this collar. Varies by quality.
LanguageData.SSC_Stat_IdleDrain_Desc: Power drain when the collar is in standby (unarmed).
LanguageData.SSC_Stat_ActiveDrain_Desc: Power drain when the collar is armed (active).
